strings.subtitle: — Mutshinyi wa faela —
strings.no_file: A hu na faela yo nangiwaho
strings.dnd_unavailable: U koka na u litsha a zwi koni. Shumisa buthoni i re fhasi.
strings.shred_button: F H E L I S A
strings.ssd_warning:
Ṱhogomelo! Kha SSD, ngila ya u ṅwala nṱha a i fulufhedzisi u fhelisa nga mulandu wa TRIM.
Purogiramu iyi ndi ya HDD.
strings.confirm_text:
Faela "{name}" i ḓo ṅwalwa nṱha nahone i ḓo thuthiwa.

Bvela phanḓa?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.error_cannot_read:
A thi koni u vhala faela:
{err}
strings.report_title: ✅  FAELA YO ṄWALWA NṰHA NA U THUTHIWA
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS milenḓe iṅwe ya data (ADS) a i shumi.
• Bugu ya USN a i kunakisiwi.
• Khopi dza murunzi na u tshimbidzana ha maphu
  (OneDrive, nw.) a zwi kwamei.
strings.step_delete: U thutha hu si na tshikwama
strings.status_full: Zwoṱhe zwo ṅwalwa nṱha nga ziro. U vhuyedza a zwi koni — zwishumiswa zwi ḓo vhona ziro fhedzi.
strings.status_fast: Ṱhoho, mutshila na milenḓe ya 4 MB zwo ṅwalwa nṱha. Zwo salaho a zwo kwamei, fhedzi nga mulandu wa mikwaha, u vhuyedza hoṱhe nga zwishumiswa zwa muthengi a zwi koni. Kha duḽa dza tshidzumbe shumisa MODE I ḒALAHO.
strings.status_empty: Faela yo vha mukoti, u ṅwala nṱha zwo vha zwi si tshee. Yo thuthiwa.
strings.error_permission: A thi koni u swikelela faela. I nga vha yo vulea kha purogiramu iṅwe. I valele nahone linga hafhu.
strings.error_not_found: Faela a yo nwali. I nga vha yo thuthiwa kale.
strings.error_is_symlink: Iyi ndi ḽiṋa ḽa tshifanyiso. Ḽiṋa a ḽi koni u fheliswa — faela ya tshikalo i ḓo sala i tshifhinga.
strings.error_reparse: Iyi ndi faela ya fhethu (OneDrive kana zwi fanaho). Data yayo i kha maphu, a i kha disiki — fhedzi a hu na tshine tsha fheliswa afha.
strings.error_not_file: Iyi a si faela (foluda kana zwiṅwe). Ita uri faela i wele.
strings.error_hardlinks: Faela iyi i na ḽiṋa ḽiṅwe ḽa khungu ({n} yoṱhe). Ḽiṋa ḽa khungu a ḽi na muhulu — madzina oṱhe a lingana. Arali wa fhelisa nga ngila ya zwino, data i ḓo ṅwalwa nṱha nahone i ḓo tsikwa kha 32 byte, fhedzi zwo salaho zwi ḓo kona u swikelelwa nga ḽiṋa ḽiṅwe. Thutha ḽiṋa ḽoṱhe u thoma.
strings.error_compressed:
Faela yo fanyisiwa, yo tsireledzwa kana ndi nyofonyofo. U ṅwala nga ziro a zwi fulufhedzisi u fhelisa data ya kale ngauri NTFS i i vhulunga nga nḓila iṅwe.

Bvisa tshiko: kliku nga u ḽonelela → Mveledziso → Yo tevhelaho → bvisa tshigwada kha "Fanyisa" na/kana "Tsireledza". Nga murahu, shumisa SHREDDER hafhu.
